title: Peak Finder
text: Determine whether each value of input signal is local minimum or maximum, 1 input, 4 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Peak type(s)} sets Type of peaks to identify Maxima and; {Index base}, {Output peak indices} enables output of peak indices, {Output peak values} enables output of peak values, {Maximum number of peaks to find} sets the maximum number of peak values to identify, {Ignore peaks within threshold of neighboring values} sets the ignore peaks below a threshold, {Threshold} and {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Data input column vector of at least three rows | matrix with at least three rows

ports.name: Cnt
ports.summary: Number of peak values scalar | row vector

ports.name: Idx
ports.summary: Indices of the peak values column vector | matrix

ports.name: Pol
ports.summary: Peak value polarity column vector | matrix

params.name: Peak type(s)
params.values: Type of peaks to identify Maxima and Minima (default) | Maxima | Minima

params.name: Output peak indices
params.values: Enable output of peak indices off (default) | on

params.name: Output peak values
params.values: Enable output of peak values off (default) | on

params.name: Maximum number of peaks to find
params.values: Maximum number of peak values to identify 10 (default) | integer greater than or equal to 1

params.name: Ignore peaks within threshold of neighboring values
params.values: Ignore peaks below a threshold off (default) | on

params.name: Threshold
params.values: Threshold below which peaks are ignored 0 (default) | positive real scalar | vector

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on
